title: Spiritual Awakening
subtitle: Test your grasp of Spiritual Awakening — Three Strings, Scare Events, EMF Flash, G.A.A., and the end of the 178,000-year occupation.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: The Great Spiritual Awakening is not med-beds, debt theater, or party politics. It is the high-velocity uninstallation of a 178,000-year occupation. Sever Religion, Finance, and Perceived Knowledge. Take the flat plain, ice wall, and Firmament as the first step. See Tartaria under the fake timeline. Watch healthcare genocidal compliance without flinching. Wi-Fi opened the pipe; EBS, Bluebeam, and the 30-second Flash close the matrix. Ninety-seven percent NPC density ends. About 520 million genuine souls remain. The Projection Dome dies; bright white dark matter shows. Memory returns in sequence. Soul Families wait beyond the ice wall. Hardwire this so eternity never buys the lie again.

questions.question: True or False: According to the report, “The Great Spiritual Awakening” refers to the current era defined by the rapid, spoon-fed dissemination of highly suppressed truths regarding planetary occupation, genetic harvesting, and the true shape and nature of the physical realm.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: True — the report defines “The Great Spiritual Awakening” this way.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: It is true — the report defines “The Great Spiritual Awakening” as: The current era defined by the rapid, spoon-fed dissemination of highly suppressed truths regarding planetary occupation, genetic harvesting, and the true shape and nature of the physical realm.

questions.hint: Recall how the report's Key Terminology defines “The Great Spiritual Awakening”.

options.rationale: Not what the report says. 178,000-year occupation ends here; satanism, child sacrifice, and parasites are forced into the open.

questions.hint: 178,000-year cycle ends — satanism, sacrifice, parasitic occupation exposed.

options.label: C

options.rationale: Not what the report says. Three Strings = Religion, Finance, Perceived Knowledge; sever them to unbind cognition.

questions.hint: Religion · Finance · Perceived Knowledge.
